name: smartcompact
description: Compacts long sessions earlier, at a pause after a commit or passing tests, to cut cost without losing results

allowLineTokens.title: Allow line (tokens)
allowLineTokens.description: Above this context size, compact at the end of a turn once a piece of work has been finished. Leave empty for the default (200000)

minFreedTokens.title: Minimum freed (tokens)
minFreedTokens.description: Skip compaction if it is expected to free less than this. Leave empty for the default (60000)
